name: UDB
title: UniFi Device Bridge
summary: Plug-in 5 GHz WiFi 5 bridge that links a wired/PoE device to UniFi WiFi via Auto-Link.

requires: UniFi WiFi network/AP to link to

extra.poe_out_note: PoE wattage/class not specified; 25W AC input vs 10W excl. PoE implies ~15W

gotchas: Only 866 Mbps 5 GHz WiFi 5 link — fine for a camera, not a multi-gig backhaul.
Single RJ45 — bridge one device (or add a switch); PoE output class unspecified (~15 W implied).
Needs AC outlet at the device end and an existing UniFi WiFi network to join.
For building-to-building links use a dedicated point-to-point bridge instead.
best_for: putting a PoE camera/AP where only power and WiFi exist
